The '''3rd [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best achievements in [[1945 in film|1945 filmmaking]], were announced March 6 and held on March 30, 1946 at the [[Knickerbocker Hotel (Los Angeles)]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]].

==Winners==

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Picture]]=== 
*''[[The Lost Weekend]]'' directed by [[Billy Wilder]]<ref>"Best Picture" http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1945 {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415111739/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1945 |date=2012-04-15 }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama|Best Actor in a Leading Role]]=== 
*[[Ray Milland]] – ''[[The Lost Weekend]]''<ref>"Best Actor in a Leading Role" http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1945 {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415111739/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1945 |date=2012-04-15 }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama|Best Actress in a Leading Role]]=== 
*[[Ingrid Bergman]] – ''[[The Bells of St. Mary's]]''<ref>"Best Actress in a Leading Role" http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1945 {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415111739/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1945 |date=2012-04-15 }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture|Best Performance by an Actor in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture]]=== 
*[[J. Carrol Naish]] – ''[[A Medal for Benny]]''<ref>"Best Performance by an Actor in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture" http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1945 {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415111739/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1945 |date=2012-04-15 }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress – Motion Picture|Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture]]=== 
*[[Angela Lansbury]] – ''[[The Picture of Dorian Gray (1945 film)|The Picture of Dorian Gray]]''<ref>"Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture" http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1945 {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415111739/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1945 |date=2012-04-15 }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Director|Best Director-Motion Picture]]=== 
*[[Billy Wilder]] – ''[[The Lost Weekend]]''<ref>"Best Director-Motion Picture" http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1945 {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415111739/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1945 |date=2012-04-15 }}</ref>

===Best Film Promoting International Understanding===
*''[[The House I Live In (1945 film)|The House I Live In]]''
